claims.claim: NIST/NCWM describes a cord as 128 cubic feet of ranked and well-stowed firewood.
claims.interpretation: Domain-specific implementation premise; jurisdiction and product variations acknowledged

claims.claim: 128 ft³ cord measures well-stowed stacked wood including air spaces, not solid wood. Species, seasoning/moisture and appliance performance drive BTU figures; values are user-supplied, not authoritative fuel certification.
